## Why the header matters
The FastAPI receiver (`src/aegis/ingress/webhook.py`) verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body and returns 401 on mismatch. n8n must forward `x-mailroom-signature` untouched, and must forward the body byte-identical — any re-serialization breaks the signature.

## Setup
- Env: `AEGIS_API_URL` (e.g. http://aegis:8000, no trailing slash)
- In AgentBoxD, point the inbox webhook at this workflow's production URL.
- Analysis + verdict reply happen inside the FastAPI service; n8n is ingress + observability only.
